notes.event_detail: Release AMC 2026-09-16; conference call is NOT the same evening but 2026-09-17 at 11:00 ET, so the overnight gap prices the release alone and the Thursday intraday session prices management commentary.
notes.macro_confound: FOMC decision with new dot plot at 14:00 ET on 2026-09-16, i.e. before the entry close, so it is largely embedded in the entry price rather than the reaction window. Fed funds 3.50-3.75% since Dec 2025; hike odds cited at 28-40%.
notes.historical_moves_note: Array is most-recent-first and contains 8 quarters (Q2FY26 back to Q3FY24) from the Trefis series. The mean/median/max abs statistics are computed on the most recent SIX only (-4.9, +2.6, -4.5, -4.2, -1.1, -4.0). Pattern: 1 up / 5 down over six quarters, 1 up / 7 down over eight.
notes.the_bar: Consensus EPS $1.29 (Zacks, cut from $1.31 in seven days) on revenue $8.33bn, sitting essentially on the midpoint of management's own $1.20-$1.40 Q3 implied-EPS guide. Zacks ESP -0.78%. An in-line Q3 is worth nothing; the swing factor is the Q4 guide.
notes.fy_arithmetic: Q1 16,863 + Q2 20,519 = 37,382 delivered; plus ~21,000 in Q3 gives ~58,400, leaving ~23,600-24,600 for Q4 against the 82,000-83,000 FY26 guide - a demanding quarter and an obvious place for a trim.
notes.positioning: Short interest 18,236,142 shares / 8.5% of float / 7.40 days to cover at the 2026-08-31 FINRA settle, rising into the print, but borrow costs only 0.37% so there is no mechanical squeeze fuel. Run-up: -7.6% over the past month vs -9.2% for the homebuilder peer group; -23% YTD; four-year low at 0.88x stated book.
notes.triage_note: Triage selection_rationale was uninformative (only eligible name in a thin universe). Independently judged: the event is genuinely researchable - single catalyst, company-published guidance bar checkable line by line, lopsided reaction base rate - but AI research adds little edge over a sell side covering the name with 20-50 analysts. The two non-obvious observations are (a) 5.2% implied vs 3.55% six-quarter realised mean, and (b) the release/call split making the overnight and intraday legs separable events.
